sign-in.alt: The Open Chat Interface sign-in page in the dark theme: the instance name, "Sign in to continue to your conversations", email and password fields, a Sign in button, and a note that the instance is invite only.

sign-in-sso.alt: The sign-in page of Example University's instance: the email and password form with Forgot your password?, then "Continue with Example University SSO" below it.

chat-home.alt: The chat home screen: the sidebar with New Chat, search, Projects and the conversation list on the left, and an empty conversation with the message box, model picker, reasoning level, Search and Attach controls.

chat-reasoning-tool-step.alt: A reply to "Can you check the status of my IT Service Desk ticket INC-2041…" with its work block expanded under the summary "Thought · used Get ticket status": a timeline of a short piece of reasoning, the tool step "Used Get ticket status" and a second piece of reasoning noting that the technician's visit clashes with the lecture, then the answer below the block.

chat-reasoning-live.alt: A reply still being written: the work block's heading "Thinking…" with a small three-line window under it showing the latest lines of the model's reasoning, the oldest line fading out.

chat-model-picker.alt: The model picker open above the message box: a search box with a capability filter, lab filters on the left, and the two models, Chat model and Fast model, each with a short description and coloured capability icons for vision, reasoning, effort control, tool calling and fast.

chat-model-details.alt: A model's information card: its name, description, capabilities, provider and limits.

chat-reply-switcher.alt: The latest reply in a conversation with the reply switcher under it reading "‹ 2 / 3 ›", beside Copy, Retry and Export as… buttons.

chat-tool-approval.alt: A reply paused on an approval card below its collapsed Reasoning heading: "Allow Create a ticket?", the tool and its connector (the IT Service Desk), the exact inputs it will run with, Approve and Deny buttons, and "Create a ticket is waiting for your approval".

chat-attachment.alt: The message box with a PDF attachment chip, "syllabus-chem101.pdf", above the question "What does section 4 say about late submissions?".

chat-long-conversation.alt: A long conversation with the line "Earlier messages are summarised for the model" expanded to show the summary the model receives: topic, facts and decisions, preferences and open questions.

sidebar-projects.alt: The sidebar with the Projects heading: "CHEM 101 teaching" expanded to its five most recent conversations and "Show all (9)", with the open conversation highlighted, two collapsed projects, then Pinned (a project conversation with its project name) and Today.

conversation-search.alt: Conversation search for "migr plan": results show each conversation's title with matching lines below and the matched words highlighted; one result is marked Archived.

project-conversations.alt: A project page, "CHEM 101 teaching", with New chat in project and the tabs Conversations, Instructions, Files and Settings, open on Conversations.

project-files.alt: The Files tab of a project: four files, three marked "Searchable · n passages" and one scanned PDF marked "No text to search".

project-passages-used.alt: A reply in a CHEM 101 project conversation with the note "Searched project files by meaning and keywords and reranked the results. Used passages from course-handbook.pdf (3 passages), lab-safety.pdf (2 passages)" expanded by Show passages used: for each file, the passage numbers and their first lines, then the answer.

project-files-control.alt: The Files control open above the message box in a project conversation: the project's files with a checkbox each, one unticked, and the button reading "Files 3/4".

artifact-writing.alt: A model writing an artifact: the reply's work block reads "Writing CHEM 101 Term Timeline…", the card below it reads the same with "HTML · 35 lines · 1,084 characters" and the last few lines written, and the docked panel beside the conversation shows the HTML source as it arrives.

artifact-panel-docked.alt: A finished reply with its work block collapsed to "Thought · created an artifact", the artifact card below it with the arrow that opens its details, and the artifact panel docked beside the conversation showing the preview of the HTML timeline, with Preview, Source and Versions tabs and Copy, Download, Full screen and Close buttons.

artifact-full-screen.alt: An SVG diagram artifact in full screen, covering the sidebar and top bar, with Exit full screen in the panel header.

settings-connectors.alt: Settings → Connectors: Course catalogue marked Not connected with a Connect button, and Docs marked Connected with a Disconnect button.

memory-settings.alt: Settings → Memory with Use memory on, an Add a memory field, and four notes, each marked Added by you or Saved by a model, with Edit and Delete.

memory-updated.alt: A reply to "Remember that I teach first-year chemistry." with its collapsed Reasoning heading, then a "Memory updated" note reading "Remembered: Teaches first-year chemistry." with an Undo button, above the answer.

share-dialog.alt: The Share conversation dialog: Share through set to "Latest messages (live)", an optional expiry, Create and copy link, and one existing link with Copy and Revoke.

settings-sharing.alt: Settings → Sharing: "Your shared links" with Revoke all, and a list of links, each with its conversation, Live or Snapshot, Active, Expired or Revoked, the dates, the view count, and Copy and Revoke.

export-menu.alt: The Export as… menu open under a reply, offering Word document, PDF, Presentation and Spreadsheet.

settings-account.alt: Settings → Account: name, email address, role and whether the email is verified, Change Password and View Devices, and the Delete account section, with the Usage Limits, Keyboard Shortcuts and Need help? cards beside the page and all eight settings tabs above.

settings-delete-account.alt: The Delete your account? dialog over Settings → Account: what is deleted and what is kept, a field to type the email address, a password field, and Delete my account.

settings-devices.alt: The Devices dialog: three signed-in sessions with browser and system, a shortened network address, when each signed in and was last active, the current one marked This device, and Sign out all other devices.

settings-customization.alt: Settings → Customization: what to call you ("Priya"), what you do ("Lecturer in chemistry"), the trait "concise" chosen from suggestions, anything else ("British spelling, please."), and Save Preferences, beside the profile, Usage Limits and Keyboard Shortcuts cards.

settings-history.alt: Settings → History: Export all conversations and Import from ChatGPT or Claude at the top, Active, Archived and Trash tabs, a title search, and a list of conversations with checkboxes, two of them ticked with Archive and Delete beside "2 selected".

settings-models.alt: Settings → Models: Defaults with Default model set to Fast model and Default reasoning level set to Instance default (Low), and Save defaults; below, Available models with a search box, Chat model marked instance default and Fast model marked your default, each with its description and capabilities.

settings-attachments.alt: Settings → Attachments: storage used against the role's limit, split into chat files, project files and artifacts, and the list of uploaded files.

phone-chat-home.alt: The chat home screen on a phone, with the sidebar closed and the composer's controls behind one button.

phone-sidebar.alt: The sidebar open as a panel on a phone, with projects and conversations.

phone-artifact.alt: An HTML artifact open on a phone, filling the screen, with its title and version, Copy, Download, Full screen and Close, and Preview, Source and Versions tabs above the preview.

phone-admin-overview.alt: The admin Overview on a phone, with the menu button that opens the admin navigation.

admin-overview.alt: Admin → Overview: the setup checklist with "5 of 6 required steps complete", Set up email delivery marked Needs attention, optional items Not set up, and totals for users, conversations, messages and storage below.

admin-providers.alt: Providers & Models, Providers tab: configured providers with their kind, whether a key is set and Discover models, and the Capacity table of waiting and streaming replies below.

admin-models.alt: Providers & Models, Models tab: the default model chooser above the catalogue, and catalogue entries with display names, capabilities, visible roles and an enabled switch.

admin-model-limits.alt: The Edit model dialog for "Chat model": provider, lab, upstream model ID, display name, slug and description above Context window 131072 and Max output 16384, then sort order and prices.

admin-embeddings.alt: Providers & Models, Embeddings tab: pgvector shown as enabled, an embeddings model with its vector size and passages embedded, and the Reranking section with its resolved /rerank endpoint.

admin-roles.alt: People → Roles & access for the user role: people with this role, models, feature switches, reasoning levels, rate limits, storage allowance and usage budgets.

admin-roles-tools.alt: The Tools section of a role on Roles & access: built-in tools and connector tools grouped under their connector, each marked read or write, with a switch.

admin-roles-delete-own-account.alt: The Features section of the user role on Roles & access, with the Delete own account switch among the other feature switches.

admin-users.alt: People → Users: a searchable, filterable list of accounts with a role selector on each row.

admin-user-detail.alt: One person's account page: totals for threads, messages, storage and files, active sessions with address and client, and limits with a monthly cost budget's progress bar and storage use.

admin-delete-user.alt: The Delete Jordan Kim? dialog on a person's account page: what is deleted and what is kept, a field to type their email address, and Delete user.

admin-users-bulk-actions.alt: Several accounts selected in the user list, with the bulk action bar offering a role, sign out and ban.

admin-invitations.alt: People → Invitations: pending invitations with their role, expiry and when each was emailed, and the Create invitation button.

admin-authentication.alt: Sign-in & security → Authentication, scrolled: the local sign-in switch, session length, and the Single sign-on section with one OpenID Connect provider, its application redirect details and its role mappings.

admin-sso-provider-form.alt: The Edit dialog for an OpenID Connect provider, scrolled to its switches (Provider enabled, Just-in-time provisioning, Trust for account linking), three group mappings from claims to roles, and Require a matching role with its message.

admin-usage-budgets.alt: Models → Usage budgets: budgets with their measure, window, model scope and the roles they apply to.

admin-retention.alt: Data & storage → Retention: conversation, trash, usage history, memory and audit log retention, each showing where its value comes from.

admin-acceptable-use.alt: Sign-in & security → Acceptable use: version 2 of "Acceptable use of the AI assistant" in force with the number of people who accepted it, version 1 superseded, and New version.

admin-announcements.alt: Appearance & features → Announcements: a maintenance banner with its audience, whether it can be dismissed, and Re-show.

admin-web-search.alt: Tools & integrations → Web search: web search on with the self-hosted SearXNG provider and its address, maximum results, Fallback provider set to None, and a successful Test search.

admin-web-search-fallback.alt: Tools & integrations → Web search: SearXNG as the provider, a second SearXNG instance as the fallback provider with its address, and Test search results for both.

admin-connectors.alt: Tools & integrations → Connectors: a connector with its server URL, authentication mode, last contact and a list of its tools with read or write and an enabled switch each.

admin-audit-log.alt: Insights → Audit log in the auditor's read-only view: a search for "auth." over the last 7 days, with entries showing time, actor, action and target, Details, and Export.

admin-usage.alt: Insights → Usage, Spend tab over 30 days: total spend, messages, tokens and people, spend per day, and spend by model, including the embeddings and reranking models.

admin-usage-deleted-accounts.alt: Insights → Usage, Top consumers: named people and one "Deleted accounts" row ranked among them.

admin-reports.alt: Insights → Reports: a monthly usage summary with its recipients, the next and last send, and the Send now, Edit, Pause and Delete buttons, with Send due now above the list.

admin-compliance.alt: Data & storage → Compliance in the auditor's read-only view: the end of the export settings, Legal holds with one person on hold and the matter reference, and a history of verified export runs.

admin-backups.alt: Data & storage → Backups: daily at 03:00 UTC with the next run and last successful backup, the pg_dump version found, Back up now, and the settings: Back up automatically and Copy attachment files on, files checked by a random sample, time of day and a separate S3 bucket as destination.

admin-backups-files.alt: Data & storage → Backups, further down: retention of daily and weekly backups, Test destination, and the history: a first run that copied every file, then runs copying only new files, each read back and checksummed, older ones marked Expired.

admin-webhooks.alt: Tools & integrations → Webhooks: an endpoint receiving backup.run and user.* events, with Send test, Rotate secret and Show deliveries.

admin-health.alt: Data & storage → System health: "Everything is responding normally." and rows for the database, Redis, model providers, models, background jobs, email delivery, attachment storage, connectors, meaning-based search, backups and webhooks, each with its status.

admin-general-settings.alt: Appearance & features → General: the default system prompt, default reasoning level, tool step limit and the Summarise long conversations switch.

admin-storage.alt: Data & storage → Storage, S3 connection tab: bucket, region, endpoint, access key ID, a configured secret access key, path-style addressing, and "S3 put, read, and delete test succeeded."

admin-branding.alt: Appearance & features → Branding: the app name and short name, logo upload and logo URL, a live preview of the sign-in page, and the accent colour presets with Blue chosen.
